_comment: Copy this to config/league.json and fill it in for YOUR league. It is gitignored (league-specific). Used by scraping/scrape_league.py and draft_sheets/build_tool_data.py.
_league_id: Your ESPN league id (the number in the fantasy.espn.com/…/leagues/<THIS> URL). Leave 0 to AUTO-DISCOVER from your cookies (scrape_league.py picks it, or lists them if you're in more than one). Ignored if you're on Sleeper.
_sleeper_league_id: SLEEPER ONLY. Your Sleeper league id (the number in the sleeper.com/leagues/<THIS>/team URL). Set this instead of league_id and run scraping/scrape_sleeper.py — no cookies needed, Sleeper's read API is public. Leave blank if you're on ESPN.
_sleeper_username: SLEEPER ONLY. Optional. Your Sleeper display name — scrape_sleeper.py matches it to a manager and writes 'me' for you (the equivalent of ESPN's SWID auto-detect).
_first_season: Optional. Earliest season your league existed — only used by scraping/scrape.py (deep history) to know how far back to pull. Defaults to 2013.
_me: The team you are drafting. Leave blank to AUTO-DETECT (scrape_league.py matches your SWID to the league members). If set, must match a manager name from the scrape (ESPN owner display name). The console tracks THIS team's budget, roster and needs.
_projections_xlsm: Path to the checked-in Elboberto projections workbook (the universal baseline). build_tool_data.py reads its CheatSheet + LeagueInfo sheets.
_my_mult: Optional positional tilt for YOUR max-bid model (how much you value each position vs. baseline). 1.0 = neutral. Raise a position to pay up for it. Leave neutral until you have a strategy.
_manager_labels: OPTIONAL. Rename a manager on the console board. ESPN reports each team's owner's real name; use this when you know a team by its team name instead - typically a mid-season substitution or a co-owned team. Keyed by the scraped name (see the build output's manager list). Tendencies merge on the RELABELLED name, so a newcomer you relabel still falls through to the league-average profile.
